# Runbook: nightly restore verification (Ostring Treuhand AG)

## Scope

Applies to Ostring Treuhand AG, contract NAT-2025-6277, site Seftigenstrasse 102, 3014 Bern.

## Before you start

Notify the customer contact Urs Schüpbach (urs.schuepbach@ostring-treuhand.ch, +41 78 455 29 18) at least one
working day ahead. If unreachable, fall back to
Urs Schüpbach (urs.schuepbach@ostring-treuhand.ch).

## Steps

1. Confirm the maintenance window in writing with Schüpbach.
2. Run the restore into the isolated network segment.
3. Record the result in the customer record (K-42601).
4. Send the report to urs.schuepbach@ostring-treuhand.ch, copy marc.aebi@natron.io.

## Notes

The monitoring portal login for this tenant is uschuepbach@ostring-treuhand.ch. That address is
functional, the vendor uses it as the account identifier, so it cannot simply be
swapped out.
